verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that users can export the code and database of apps they built and deploy those apps elsewhere. It does not show that the Floot builder platform itself (editor, AI assistant, MCP server) can be self-hosted. Exporting generated apps is an adjacent capability, not self-hosting the core product. The MCP manifest describes only a vendor-hosted remote endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: you can export the code and the database and deploy them wherever you like.
A Floot project is a real TypeScript and React app — pages, components, and backend endpoints — and you can read or export all of it.
